sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_profile" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "age_years" INTEGER NULL, "height_cm" REAL NULL, "sex" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unspecified', "activity_level" TEXT NULL, "training_experience" TEXT NULL, "training_frequency_per_week" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fitness_goals" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "goal_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_primary" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_primary" IN (0, 1)), "target_weight_kg" REAL NULL, "target_date" INTEGER NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "completed_at" INTEGER NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "weight_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "recorded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "nutrition_targets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "calories" INTEGER NOT NULL, "protein_g" REAL NULL, "carbs_g" REAL NULL, "fat_g" REAL NULL, "effective_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, "reference_basis" TEXT NOT NULL, "serving_size" REAL NULL, "serving_unit" TEXT NULL CHECK("serving_unit" IN ('g', 'ml')), "serving_description" TEXT NULL, "kcal" REAL NULL, "protein_g" REAL NULL, "carbs_g" REAL NULL, "fat_g" REAL NULL, "fiber_g" REAL NULL, "sugar_g" REAL NULL, "sodium_mg" REAL NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "external_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "food_item_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES food_items (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "quantity" REAL NOT NULL, "quantity_unit" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("quantity_unit" IN ('g', 'ml', 'serving')), "meal_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "consumed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "kcal" REAL NULL, "protein_g" REAL NULL, "carbs_g" REAL NULL, "fat_g" REAL NULL, "fiber_g" REAL NULL, "sugar_g" REAL NULL, "sodium_mg" REAL NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercises" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "muscle_group" TEXT NOT NULL, "equipment" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "is_bodyweight" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_bodyweight" IN (0, 1)), "is_custom" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_custom" IN (0, 1)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sessions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_exercises" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "exercise_name_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_index" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "workout_exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_exercises (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "set_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "repetitions" INTEGER NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NULL, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("completed" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dashboard_cards" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "card_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_visible" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_visible" IN (0, 1)), "card_size" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'regular', "config_json" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("id" = 1), "unit_system" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'metric', "theme_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system' CHECK("theme_mode" IN ('system', 'light', 'dark')), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_metadata" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("id" = 1), "data_format_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "onboarding_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("onboarding_completed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "food_item_id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES food_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "servings" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("servings" >= 1), "bundled_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "source_version" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipe_ingredients" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "recipe_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES recipes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "food_item_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES food_items (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "quantity" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("quantity" > 0.0), "unit" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("unit" IN ('g', 'ml', 'serving')), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL);
